# RB-18 Release or migration rollback

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | A journey broken after a release, A migration that misbehaves in production                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| First checks                  | Confirm the production deployment and the last applied migration from a deploy readback. Find the change that caused it and read its rollback note: B01 design §16, B02 design §7 and the note at the top of each migration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Steps                         | Lightest first: (1) a UI switch back to the earlier behaviour (SW-04 to SW-07) or a narrower data switch (SW-01); (2) promote the previous deployment: the B01 and B02 migrations are additive and B02 re-created existing functions with the same signatures and only additive result keys (B02 design §7.1), so the earlier app keeps working; check the rollback note of any later release before relying on this; (3) a forward migration that restores earlier function bodies or grants, written from the rollback note, rehearsed on an owned stack and reviewed. Schema is forward-only: never drop a table that holds data, disable a trigger, or edit an applied migration. Coverage has its own withdrawal (SW-14). Every production step needs the owner's sign-off (X1). |
| Narrowest switch              | A UI switch (SW-04 to SW-07) or the working list (SW-01) before any deployment change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Switches in the catalogue     | SW-04 (Staff Home layout (B02 or B01)), SW-05 (Shared Add entry (B02 or B01)), SW-06 (Manager triage (B02 or B01)), SW-07 (My contributions (B02 or B01)), SW-01 (Knowledge working list (per venue and question)), SW-14 (Coverage access withdrawal)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Data implications             | Rows written under the newer release are kept and stay readable by the earlier app; nothing is deleted or converted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Pending delivery              | No consumer delivery is involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Readback that proves recovery | The deploy readback shows the intended deployment and migration list, and the broken journey works.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

## Checks without a database

- unit: `tests/unit/ops-switches.test.ts`: Each B02 switch falls back to b01 when set, per venue where it has a list, and defaults to b02
- static: `supabase/migrations`: Every released migration since B01 carries a rollback note (checked in tests/unit/ops-runbooks.test.ts)

## Drill

- Description: On an owned stack: apply the release's migrations, run the earlier app's focused tests against them, then apply the forward restore and run them again. The coverage withdrawal rehearsal (node tests/migrations/run.mjs <stack> withdraw) is the existing base.
- Readiness: ready_on_main
- Status: queued
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-18/`
